items.title: Epoch updates its Capabilities Index (ECI) to a Bayesian methodology
items.summary_en: Epoch AI published a methodology update moving the Epoch Capabilities Index to a Bayesian model meant to give better-calibrated uncertainty. According to the search summary, every model's new ECI falls inside its previous 90% confidence interval, and models above ECI 150 tend to move up slightly.
items.notes: Search summary only; date, authors and figures need human checking.

items.title: Data insight: Broadcom TPU shipments doubled to about 2M H100-equivalents
items.summary_en: An Epoch data insight estimates Broadcom's TPU-related compute shipments reached roughly 2 million H100-equivalents, double the earlier level. The summary says the estimate uses Broadcom's Q3 hardware revenue after removing VMware license revenue.
items.notes: Search summary only. An Epoch estimate, not a company-reported figure.

items.title: Epoch data-center tracker updated: Anthropic-Amazon New Carlisle listed as largest
items.summary_en: Epoch's ranking of AI data centers by power capacity was reportedly updated in early November 2026. According to the search summary, the Anthropic-Amazon New Carlisle site is the largest tracked facility, at about 1,037 MW of current IT power.
items.notes: Living dataset; date is an update date. Figure unverified.
